reason: In lib/topic_retriever.rb:27-28, retrieved_recently? calls $redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1") and $redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60) as two separate Redis commands (proxied directly in lib/discourse_redis.rb:46-57). If a crash or connection failure occurs between them, the key persists without a TTL and subsequent throttled calls always see setnx return false, blocking retrieval of that URL unless bypassed by staff or cleared manually.
